ai_staffing_assessments_status_check.name: ai_staffing_assessments_status_check
ai_staffing_assessments_status_check.value:
("ai_staffing_assessments"."status" = 'AVAILABLE' and "ai_staffing_assessments"."assessment" is not null and "ai_staffing_assessments"."failure_code" is null and "ai_staffing_assessments"."response_model" is not null)
    or ("ai_staffing_assessments"."status" = 'FAILED' and "ai_staffing_assessments"."assessment" is null and "ai_staffing_assessments"."failure_code" is not null)

ai_staffing_assessments_scope_check.name: ai_staffing_assessments_scope_check
ai_staffing_assessments_scope_check.value: ("ai_staffing_assessments"."scope_key" = 'ORGANISATION' and "ai_staffing_assessments"."outlet_id" is null) or ("ai_staffing_assessments"."outlet_id" is not null and "ai_staffing_assessments"."scope_key" = 'LOCATION:' || "ai_staffing_assessments"."outlet_id"::text)

demand_context_decisions_scenario_check.name: demand_context_decisions_scenario_check
demand_context_decisions_scenario_check.value:
("demand_context_decisions"."scenario" = 'NONE' and "demand_context_decisions"."adjustment_bps" = 0) or ("demand_context_decisions"."scenario" = 'MINOR_UP' and "demand_context_decisions"."adjustment_bps" = 500)
    or ("demand_context_decisions"."scenario" = 'MODERATE_UP' and "demand_context_decisions"."adjustment_bps" = 1000) or ("demand_context_decisions"."scenario" = 'MINOR_DOWN' and "demand_context_decisions"."adjustment_bps" = -500) or ("demand_context_decisions"."scenario" = 'MODERATE_DOWN' and "demand_context_decisions"."adjustment_bps" = -1000)

demand_context_proposals_status_check.name: demand_context_proposals_status_check
demand_context_proposals_status_check.value:
("demand_context_proposals"."status" = 'AVAILABLE' and "demand_context_proposals"."scenario" in ('NONE', 'MINOR_UP', 'MODERATE_UP', 'MINOR_DOWN', 'MODERATE_DOWN') and "demand_context_proposals"."cited_signal_ids" is not null and "demand_context_proposals"."reason" is not null and "demand_context_proposals"."failure_code" is null and "demand_context_proposals"."response_model" is not null)
    or ("demand_context_proposals"."status" = 'FAILED' and "demand_context_proposals"."scenario" is null and "demand_context_proposals"."cited_signal_ids" is null and "demand_context_proposals"."reason" is null and "demand_context_proposals"."failure_code" is not null)

demand_context_proposals_period_check.name: demand_context_proposals_period_check
demand_context_proposals_period_check.value: ("demand_context_proposals"."period_start" is null and "demand_context_proposals"."period_end" is null) or ("demand_context_proposals"."status" = 'AVAILABLE' and "demand_context_proposals"."period_start" >= 0 and "demand_context_proposals"."period_end" <= 1440 and "demand_context_proposals"."period_start" < "demand_context_proposals"."period_end")

demand_context_signals_provenance_check.name: demand_context_signals_provenance_check
demand_context_signals_provenance_check.value:
("demand_context_signals"."signal_type" = 'MOMENTUM' and "demand_context_signals"."provenance" = 'DETERMINISTIC_CALCULATION')
    or ("demand_context_signals"."signal_type" in ('MANAGER_ENTERED', 'BOOKINGS', 'LOCAL_EVENT', 'PROMOTION') and "demand_context_signals"."provenance" = 'MANAGER_ENTERED' and "demand_context_signals"."entered_by" is not null)
    or ("demand_context_signals"."signal_type" = 'LOCAL_EVENT' and "demand_context_signals"."provenance" = 'PROVIDER_EVENT')
    or ("demand_context_signals"."signal_type" = 'BANK_HOLIDAY' and "demand_context_signals"."provenance" = 'OFFICIAL_SNAPSHOT')
    or ("demand_context_signals"."signal_type" = 'WEATHER_FORECAST' and "demand_context_signals"."provenance" = 'PROVIDER_FORECAST')

demand_context_signals_time_check.name: demand_context_signals_time_check
demand_context_signals_time_check.value: ("demand_context_signals"."period_start" is null and "demand_context_signals"."period_end" is null) or ("demand_context_signals"."period_start" >= 0 and "demand_context_signals"."period_end" <= 1440 and "demand_context_signals"."period_start" < "demand_context_signals"."period_end")

labour_policies_status_check.name: labour_policies_status_check
labour_policies_status_check.value: ("labour_policies"."status" = 'ACTIVE' and "labour_policies"."superseded_at" is null) or ("labour_policies"."status" = 'SUPERSEDED' and "labour_policies"."superseded_at" is not null)

membership_scope_check.name: membership_scope_check
membership_scope_check.value: ("organisation_memberships"."role" = 'OWNER' and "organisation_memberships"."outlet_id" is null and "organisation_memberships"."worker_id" is null and "organisation_memberships"."invitation_id" is null) or ("organisation_memberships"."role" = 'MANAGER' and "organisation_memberships"."outlet_id" is not null and "organisation_memberships"."worker_id" is null and "organisation_memberships"."invitation_id" is not null) or ("organisation_memberships"."role" = 'TEAM_MEMBER' and "organisation_memberships"."outlet_id" is not null and "organisation_memberships"."worker_id" is not null and "organisation_memberships"."invitation_id" is not null)

outlets_coordinates_check.name: outlets_coordinates_check
outlets_coordinates_check.value: ("outlets"."latitude" is null and "outlets"."longitude" is null) or ("outlets"."latitude" between -90 and 90 and "outlets"."longitude" between -180 and 180)

pay_agent_events_claim_check.name: pay_agent_events_claim_check
pay_agent_events_claim_check.value: ("pay_agent_events"."status" in ('CLAIMED', 'SETTLING')) = ("pay_agent_events"."claim_token" is not null and "pay_agent_events"."lease_expires_at" is not null and "pay_agent_events"."claimed_at" is not null)

pay_agent_events_error_check.name: pay_agent_events_error_check
pay_agent_events_error_check.value: "pay_agent_events"."status" not in ('REJECTED_OUTPUT', 'FAILED_RETRYABLE', 'FAILED_TERMINAL') or "pay_agent_events"."error_class" is not null

pay_agent_events_decision_check.name: pay_agent_events_decision_check
pay_agent_events_decision_check.value:
("pay_agent_events"."decision" is null and "pay_agent_events"."reason_code" is null and "pay_agent_events"."summary" is null and "pay_agent_events"."decided_at" is null)
    or ("pay_agent_events"."decision" = 'SETTLE' and "pay_agent_events"."reason_code" is null and "pay_agent_events"."summary" is null and "pay_agent_events"."decided_at" is not null)
    or ("pay_agent_events"."decision" = 'HOLD' and "pay_agent_events"."reason_code" in ('HOURS_MISMATCH', 'INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE', 'CONFIRMATION_DELAY', 'CONFLICTING_RECORDS') and char_length("pay_agent_events"."summary") between 1 and 200 and "pay_agent_events"."decided_at" is not null)

pay_agent_events_resolution_check.name: pay_agent_events_resolution_check
pay_agent_events_resolution_check.value:
("pay_agent_events"."resolution" is null and "pay_agent_events"."resolved_by" is null and "pay_agent_events"."resolved_at" is null and "pay_agent_events"."resolution_note" is null)
    or ("pay_agent_events"."resolution" = 'RELEASED' and "pay_agent_events"."decision" = 'HOLD' and "pay_agent_events"."resolved_by" is not null and "pay_agent_events"."resolved_at" is not null and coalesce(char_length("pay_agent_events"."resolution_note"), 0) <= 500)
    or ("pay_agent_events"."resolution" = 'REJECTED' and "pay_agent_events"."decision" = 'HOLD' and "pay_agent_events"."resolved_by" is not null and "pay_agent_events"."resolved_at" is not null and char_length("pay_agent_events"."resolution_note") between 1 and 500)

pay_agent_events_resolved_status_check.name: pay_agent_events_resolved_status_check
pay_agent_events_resolved_status_check.value: ("pay_agent_events"."status" <> 'HOLD_RELEASED' or "pay_agent_events"."resolution" = 'RELEASED') and ("pay_agent_events"."status" <> 'HOLD_REJECTED' or "pay_agent_events"."resolution" = 'REJECTED') and ("pay_agent_events"."status" <> 'DECIDED_HOLD' or "pay_agent_events"."resolution" is null)

sale_transactions_demo_provenance_check.name: sale_transactions_demo_provenance_check
sale_transactions_demo_provenance_check.value:
"sale_transactions"."source" != 'DEMO_SEEDED' or (
      "sale_transactions"."paypal_order_id" is null and "sale_transactions"."paypal_capture_id" is null and
      "sale_transactions"."paypal_custom_id" is null and "sale_transactions"."provider_created_at" is null and
      "sale_transactions"."provider_updated_at" is null and "sale_transactions"."reconciled_at" is null and
      "sale_transactions"."verification_state" = 'PENDING' and "sale_transactions"."reconciliation_state" = 'NOT_RECONCILED' and
      "sale_transactions"."provider_status" = 'DEMO_SEEDED'
    )

sale_transactions_reference_provenance_c.name: sale_transactions_reference_provenance_check
sale_transactions_reference_provenance_c.value:
"sale_transactions"."source" != 'REFERENCE' or (
      "sale_transactions"."paypal_order_id" is null and "sale_transactions"."paypal_capture_id" is null and
      "sale_transactions"."paypal_custom_id" is null and "sale_transactions"."provider_created_at" is null and
      "sale_transactions"."provider_updated_at" is null and "sale_transactions"."reconciled_at" is null and
      "sale_transactions"."verification_state" = 'PENDING' and "sale_transactions"."reconciliation_state" = 'NOT_RECONCILED' and
      "sale_transactions"."provider_status" = 'REFERENCE' and "sale_transactions"."occurred_at" is not null
    )

sale_transactions_imported_provenance_ch.name: sale_transactions_imported_provenance_check
sale_transactions_imported_provenance_ch.value:
"sale_transactions"."source" != 'IMPORTED' or (
      "sale_transactions"."paypal_order_id" is null and "sale_transactions"."paypal_capture_id" is null and
      "sale_transactions"."paypal_custom_id" is null and "sale_transactions"."provider_created_at" is null and
      "sale_transactions"."provider_updated_at" is null and "sale_transactions"."reconciled_at" is null and
      "sale_transactions"."verification_state" = 'PENDING' and "sale_transactions"."reconciliation_state" = 'NOT_RECONCILED' and
      "sale_transactions"."provider_status" = 'IMPORTED' and "sale_transactions"."occurred_at" is not null and
      "sale_transactions"."source_system" is not null and "sale_transactions"."source_transaction_id" is not null
    )

sale_transactions_zettle_provenance_chec.name: sale_transactions_zettle_provenance_check
sale_transactions_zettle_provenance_chec.value:
"sale_transactions"."source" != 'ZETTLE' or (
      "sale_transactions"."paypal_order_id" is null and "sale_transactions"."paypal_capture_id" is null and
      "sale_transactions"."paypal_custom_id" is null and "sale_transactions"."provider_created_at" is null and
      "sale_transactions"."provider_updated_at" is null and "sale_transactions"."reconciled_at" is null and
      "sale_transactions"."verification_state" = 'PENDING' and "sale_transactions"."reconciliation_state" = 'NOT_RECONCILED' and
      "sale_transactions"."provider_status" = 'ZETTLE' and "sale_transactions"."occurred_at" is not null and
      "sale_transactions"."source_system" is not null and "sale_transactions"."source_transaction_id" is not null
    )

sale_transactions_square_provenance_chec.name: sale_transactions_square_provenance_check
sale_transactions_square_provenance_chec.value:
"sale_transactions"."source" != 'SQUARE' or (
      "sale_transactions"."paypal_order_id" is null and "sale_transactions"."paypal_capture_id" is null and
      "sale_transactions"."paypal_custom_id" is null and "sale_transactions"."provider_created_at" is null and
      "sale_transactions"."provider_updated_at" is null and "sale_transactions"."reconciled_at" is null and
      "sale_transactions"."verification_state" = 'PENDING' and "sale_transactions"."reconciliation_state" = 'NOT_RECONCILED' and
      "sale_transactions"."provider_status" = 'SQUARE' and "sale_transactions"."occurred_at" is not null and
      "sale_transactions"."source_system" is not null and "sale_transactions"."source_transaction_id" is not null
    )

shift_incentives_approval_check.name: shift_incentives_approval_check
shift_incentives_approval_check.value: ("shift_incentives"."status" in ('APPROVED', 'SUBMITTING', 'SUBMITTED', 'PROCESSING', 'PAID', 'FAILED') and "shift_incentives"."approved_at" is not null and "shift_incentives"."approved_by" is not null) or ("shift_incentives"."status" in ('NOT_EARNED', 'EARNED') and "shift_incentives"."approved_at" is null and "shift_incentives"."approved_by" is null)

shift_incentives_payout_eligibility_chec.name: shift_incentives_payout_eligibility_check
shift_incentives_payout_eligibility_chec.value: "shift_incentives"."status" not in ('SUBMITTING', 'SUBMITTED', 'PROCESSING', 'PAID') or ("shift_incentives"."earned_amount_minor" > 0 and "shift_incentives"."payout_recipient" is not null and "shift_incentives"."approved_at" is not null)

shift_offers_acceptance_check.name: shift_offers_acceptance_check
shift_offers_acceptance_check.value:
("shift_offers"."status" = 'ACCEPTED' and "shift_offers"."accepted_at" is not null and "shift_offers"."responded_at" is not null)
          or ("shift_offers"."status" != 'ACCEPTED' and "shift_offers"."accepted_at" is null)

staff_destination_events_kind_check.name: staff_destination_events_kind_check
staff_destination_events_kind_check.value: ("staff_destination_events"."kind" = 'RECORDED' and "staff_destination_events"."recorded_by" is not null and "staff_destination_events"."link_id" is null) or ("staff_destination_events"."kind" in ('CONFIRMED', 'CHANGED') and "staff_destination_events"."link_id" is not null)

subscription_location_limit_check.name: subscription_location_limit_check
subscription_location_limit_check.value: case when "organisation_subscriptions"."tier" is null then "organisation_subscriptions"."location_limit" is null and "organisation_subscriptions"."billing_period" is null when "organisation_subscriptions"."tier" = 'SINGLE_OUTLET' then coalesce("organisation_subscriptions"."location_limit" = 1 and "organisation_subscriptions"."billing_period" is not null, false) when "organisation_subscriptions"."tier" = 'MULTI_OUTLET' then coalesce("organisation_subscriptions"."location_limit" = 5 and "organisation_subscriptions"."billing_period" is not null, false) when "organisation_subscriptions"."tier" = 'ENTERPRISE' then coalesce("organisation_subscriptions"."location_limit" > 0, false) else false end

tip_agent_events_claim_check.name: tip_agent_events_claim_check
tip_agent_events_claim_check.value: ("tip_agent_events"."status" in ('CLAIMED', 'SETTLING')) = ("tip_agent_events"."claim_token" is not null and "tip_agent_events"."lease_expires_at" is not null and "tip_agent_events"."claimed_at" is not null)

tip_agent_events_decision_check.name: tip_agent_events_decision_check
tip_agent_events_decision_check.value:
("tip_agent_events"."decision" is null and "tip_agent_events"."reason_code" is null and "tip_agent_events"."summary" is null and "tip_agent_events"."decided_at" is null)
    or ("tip_agent_events"."decision" = 'RELEASE' and "tip_agent_events"."reason_code" is null and "tip_agent_events"."summary" is null and "tip_agent_events"."decided_at" is not null)
    or ("tip_agent_events"."decision" = 'HOLD' and "tip_agent_events"."reason_code" in ('UNATTRIBUTED_TIPS', 'INACTIVE_STAFF_ATTRIBUTION', 'TIP_OUTLIER', 'RECONCILIATION_GAP', 'DUPLICATE_ROWS', 'ROSTER_MISMATCH') and char_length("tip_agent_events"."summary") between 1 and 200 and "tip_agent_events"."decided_at" is not null)

tip_allocations_policy_check.name: tip_allocations_policy_check
tip_allocations_policy_check.value: ("tip_allocations"."policy" = 'DIRECT' and "tip_allocations"."block_key" = 'DAY' and "tip_allocations"."block_id" is null) or ("tip_allocations"."policy" = 'SHIFT_POOL' and "tip_allocations"."block_id" is not null and "tip_allocations"."block_key" = "tip_allocations"."block_id"::text and "tip_allocations"."block_name" is not null)

tip_evidence_rows_amount_check.name: tip_evidence_rows_amount_check
tip_evidence_rows_amount_check.value: "tip_evidence_rows"."bill_minor" between 0 and 9007199254740991 and "tip_evidence_rows"."tip_minor" between 1 and 9007199254740991 and "tip_evidence_rows"."currency_code" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$'

tip_evidence_rows_disposition_check.name: tip_evidence_rows_disposition_check
tip_evidence_rows_disposition_check.value: ("tip_evidence_rows"."disposition" in ('POOL', 'DIRECT') and "tip_evidence_rows"."allocation_id" is not null) or ("tip_evidence_rows"."disposition" in ('CASUAL_SHIFT_PAY', 'OUTSIDE_BLOCKS') and "tip_evidence_rows"."allocation_id" is null) or "tip_evidence_rows"."disposition" = 'UNATTRIBUTED'

tip_holds_source_check.name: tip_holds_source_check
tip_holds_source_check.value:
("tip_holds"."source" = 'MODEL' and "tip_holds"."line_id" is null and "tip_holds"."tip_agent_event_id" is not null and "tip_holds"."reason_code" in ('UNATTRIBUTED_TIPS', 'INACTIVE_STAFF_ATTRIBUTION', 'TIP_OUTLIER', 'RECONCILIATION_GAP', 'DUPLICATE_ROWS', 'ROSTER_MISMATCH'))
    or ("tip_holds"."source" = 'DETERMINISTIC' and "tip_holds"."line_id" is not null and "tip_holds"."reason_code" in ('AUTO_RELEASE_CAP_EXCEEDED', 'DESTINATION_RECENTLY_CHANGED'))

work_payables_amounts_check.name: work_payables_amounts_check
work_payables_amounts_check.value: "work_payables"."rate_minor" between 0 and 9007199254740991 and "work_payables"."base_amount_minor" between 0 and 9007199254740991 and "work_payables"."terms_version" > 0

work_payables_incentive_check.name: work_payables_incentive_check
work_payables_incentive_check.value: ("work_payables"."incentive_amount_minor" is null and "work_payables"."performance_result_id" is null) or ("work_payables"."incentive_required" and "work_payables"."incentive_amount_minor" is not null and "work_payables"."incentive_amount_minor" between 0 and 9007199254740991 and "work_payables"."performance_result_id" is not null)

work_payables_approval_check.name: work_payables_approval_check
work_payables_approval_check.value:
("work_payables"."status" = 'PENDING_REVIEW' and "work_payables"."approved_at" is null and "work_payables"."approved_by" is null and "work_payables"."approved_amount_minor" is null and "work_payables"."approved_currency_code" is null)
    or ("work_payables"."status" = 'APPROVED' and "work_payables"."approved_at" is not null and "work_payables"."approved_by" is not null and "work_payables"."approved_amount_minor" is not null and "work_payables"."approved_amount_minor" = "work_payables"."base_amount_minor" + coalesce("work_payables"."incentive_amount_minor", 0) and "work_payables"."approved_currency_code" = "work_payables"."currency_code" and (not "work_payables"."incentive_required" or "work_payables"."incentive_amount_minor" is not null))

work_payouts_provider_conversion_check.name: work_payouts_provider_conversion_check
work_payouts_provider_conversion_check.value: ("work_payouts"."fx_rate_micros" is null and "work_payouts"."fx_rate_source" is null and "work_payouts"."provider_currency" = "work_payouts"."currency_code" and "work_payouts"."provider_amount_minor" = "work_payouts"."amount_minor") or ("work_payouts"."fx_rate_micros" is not null and "work_payouts"."fx_rate_micros" > 0 and "work_payouts"."fx_rate_source" is not null and "work_payouts"."provider_currency" <> "work_payouts"."currency_code" and "work_payouts"."provider_amount_minor" = div("work_payouts"."amount_minor"::numeric * 1000000, "work_payouts"."fx_rate_micros"::numeric))

work_payouts_provider_check.name: work_payouts_provider_check
work_payouts_provider_check.value: ("work_payouts"."status" not in ('PROCESSING', 'PAID') or "work_payouts"."paypal_batch_id" is not null) and ("work_payouts"."status" not in ('SUBMITTING', 'NOT_SENT') or "work_payouts"."paypal_batch_id" is null)

work_performance_results_amounts_check.name: work_performance_results_amounts_check
work_performance_results_amounts_check.value: "work_performance_results"."sales_count" >= 0 and "work_performance_results"."sales_minor" between 0 and 9007199254740991 and "work_performance_results"."target_minor" > 0 and "work_performance_results"."bonus_minor" > 0 and ("work_performance_results"."sales_count" > 0 or "work_performance_results"."sales_minor" = 0)

work_policy_incentive_check.name: work_policy_incentive_check

work_policy_terms_check.name: work_policy_terms_check

workload_policies_status_check.name: workload_policies_status_check
workload_policies_status_check.value: ("workload_policies"."status" = 'ACTIVE' and "workload_policies"."superseded_at" is null) or ("workload_policies"."status" = 'SUPERSEDED' and "workload_policies"."superseded_at" is not null)
